title: How a Godly Man Works Hard Without Needing His Job to Prove He's a Man
caption:
How a godly man works hard without needing his job to prove he's a man. Ambition and identity aren't the same thing.

God put the drive in you. He didn't put your worth in the title on your badge. Watch what a bad day does to you. If a missed promotion can ruin your whole week, something other than Christ is holding your identity.

Colossians 3:23: work at it with all your heart, as working for the Lord. The Lord, not whoever's ranked above you. Let your work serve people, not your reputation. The moment work stops being for anyone but you, it's stopped being worship and started being an idol with a paycheck.

Would you still be you if the job disappeared tomorrow?
